decision: The Dramaturgo selects significant moments and their dramatic timing. The Narrador presents those situations. The player plays consequential scenes and controls the protagonist's choices; ordinary chronology and travel need not be simulated turn-by-turn.
interpretation: An ongoing player's present position is a historical checkpoint, not a command to start the next dramatic scene at the same instant
The Dramaturgo may select the next consequential scene in minutes, days, weeks, months or longer, with legitimate dramatic and causal continuity
Routine, unimportant actions and uneventful intervals may be elided without asking the player to authorize each waking, drive or workplace visit
NPCs and external world events can initiate scenes independently; motives, capability, time and knowledge must remain credible
Never predetermine Bartholomeu's consequential choice, acceptance, encounter outcome, test or transformation
Any earlier mandatory generic NEXT_INTENTION_FROM_LAST_CHECKPOINT gate is prospectively superseded if it was imposed only to animate routine chronological continuity
Do not erase an explicit, meaningful, unresolved player action or priority during an ellipsis
authority_boundary: This is local prospective direction; no prior played event, frozen canon, old decisions, XP/FV, NPC knowledge or Embrace is changed. Not a general waiver of scene authorization, causal gates or mechanical checks.
previous_operational_pause: CYCLE_V0039 INTENTION_PENDING; no player intent was declared or recorded there.
new_goal: Eligible Dramaturgo-selected spotlight with validated scene and Narrator grants; no simulated intervening daily scenes.
